name: usage-bar
description: A board above the prompt with your 5-hour and weekly limit usage and when each resets; warns when a session gets expensive.

costWarnUsd.title: Session cost warning (USD)
costWarnUsd.description: Toast when this session's cost passes this amount, then again at each doubling.

turnCostWarnUsd.title: Single turn cost warning (USD)
turnCostWarnUsd.description: Toast when one prompt-to-answer turn costs at least this much.

limitWarnPct.title: Limit warning (%)
limitWarnPct.description: Toast when the 5-hour or weekly limit reaches this percentage (and again at 95%).
